content: Tumor-Source Validation and FTV-Based pCR Prediction in I-SPY2 Breast MRI with an Exploratory Temporal 3DGCNN Framework
purpose: Honest title. It names FTV as the main result and 3DGCNN as exploratory.

content: Summarize tumor-source validation, FTV model result, and exploratory 3DGCNN framework.
Explain pCR prediction, ISPY2 MRI, tumor-source reliability, and why temporal graph learning is attractive.
Describe ISPY2 on Cradle, DICOM inventory, and support-data feature source.
Describe DICOM SEG diagnosis and why raw masks were not used as the main source.
Describe pCR label merge, FTV features, and classical ML models.
Describe patient-visit graph, node features, temporal edges, GCN layers, and graph pooling.
Report model ranking. FTV SVM is best; 3DGCNN is exploratory.
Explain why tumor-source validation matters and why GNN should remain future work.
Small sample, no clinical validation, conceptual flow visuals, and limited validated 3D masks.
Expand longitudinal FTV/PE/SER graph cohort and true tumor-region node features.
